_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Simulator settings and results now have separate scrollable views, a collapsible USB/cuff setup guide and persistent progress, Start/STOP, recordings folder and MAP scatter controls. Existing bench tools, paired BP lists, green/red outcomes, one-cycle recordings and 30-second breaks remain available.

The settings and queue height adapts to short windows, keeping actions visible. Arm CVP comparisons at 40, 72 and 150 bpm reduced valve steps around 20 mmHg from 0.07 to 0.01–0.02 duty points, with less than 2% change in mean pulse amplitude. Wrist CVP at 150 bpm completed with 0.01 duty-point steps. Deflation at 8–12 mmHg remains about 0.51 mmHg/s. The difficult Smart Const 120/80, 150 bpm, 0.30 mL bench trial detected 94.0 mmHg versus a setpoint reference of 93.3 and held 99 mmHg. All native NI/Arduino captures were continuous; a 10.92-second buffered NI delivery delay recovered during the Arm test.

Smart Const uses calibrated raw pressure, measured cadence, repeatable harmonic pulse fits and a bounded envelope fit. Tiny, flat, noisy or unsupported envelopes retain fallback. Accepted MAP sets reinflation and hold to MAP+5. CVP approaches each measured-rate valve decision smoothly within existing actuator bounds. No calibration, valve limits or safety thresholds changed.

The MAP scatter excludes fallback holds and labels reference MAP as DP+(SP-DP)/3 from simulator settings. Existing-cohort replay improved from 65 to 85 accepted estimates out of 89, with RMSE 4.62 to 2.52 mmHg; this is development evidence, not independent device/cuff qualification. Figure09b retains the unresolved approximately 45% volume excess without tuning calibration to simulator truth.

Protected Device D flash verified all stored calibration, PID, feedforward and valve settings. Seed213 ten-minute soak completed six cycles with 100% exact telemetry delivery and all actuator reversal checks passing. Both GUI/standalone parity checks and layout/smoke checks passed. Native NI pulse comparisons are retained with immutable NI timing. Firmware rev27v-followup-287.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
